objective: Eliminate status/PDF/document drift by introducing one canonical machine-readable project-status source and generating/verifying the executive tracker plus current documentation from it. Reconcile the stale README E3/E4/E5 roadmap, stale current_company_state evidence header, later Career discovery completions, and all real production blockers without erasing historical evidence.
prerequisites: Inspect current main after the three Career discovery tasks ahead of this task have reached a terminal state so the generated status includes their final evidence.
Reuse existing roster, acceptance evidence, deployment preflight and owner-action files as inputs; do not create a competing truth hierarchy.
allowed_scope: Design a canonical machine-readable status artifact (JSON/YAML) containing: current code/release identity, E1-E5 state, roster accounting, latest evidence timestamp(s), regression counts, Career discovery state, queue/service state, provider credential readiness, Stage2 state, deployment state, owner-gated items and production blockers.
Populate it only from verifiable repository/runtime evidence with source references and timestamps; UNKNOWN must remain UNKNOWN.

Create a deterministic generator/renderer for the executive tracker from that canonical status source. The generated output must include later high-recall semantic discovery and unified recruiter/LinkedIn discovery work, plus subsequent open-web/watchlist/schedule work if completed by then.
Add a verification command/test that fails when the committed/generated tracker or derived status summaries are stale relative to the canonical status artifact.

Update README's Executive Brain roadmap so it no longer says E3 planned / E4-E5 future when current evidence says otherwise. Preserve nuance between implemented/verified, Stage2 enabled, and production deployed.
Reconcile state/current_company_state.md so its header/latest-evidence metadata reflects the newest incorporated evidence while preserving the historical evidence chronology below it.

Represent production blockers explicitly and separately from implementation completion: seven remaining provider credentials absent, Stage2 disabled, live-provider failover gap, deployment/cutover decision, off-site backup, battery gating, reboot persistence, laptop trust audit, and other owner-gated optional integrations as currently evidenced.

Do not label Gmail OAuth, research provider, LinkedIn live account access, recruiter live feed or regional work-authorisation decisions as core production blockers unless the documented product scope actually requires them; distinguish optional/feature-gated coverage from release blockers.
Add CI/local verification to compare generated artifacts/status against source evidence without accessing secrets.
Commit/push generated artifacts and generator sources with exact generation command and evidence timestamp.
stop_conditions: Do not overwrite historical acceptance evidence.
Do not turn owner-gated UNKNOWNs into PASS.
Do not claim production-ready while deployment blockers remain.
Do not hand-edit the generated tracker as the primary maintenance path once the generator exists.
notes: Independent audit found the PDF visually sound but statically drifting, README roadmap stale, and current_company_state header older than later work. Goal is one project-level view that can be regenerated and verified rather than manually synchronized.
